title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Jai Hind
desc: After his brother is killed in a terrorist attack, Bharat, a policeman, assures his mother that he will resign. However, when he learns of a secret terrorist organisation he sets out to capture them.

title: Bala
desc: Bala, a hitman, falls for the daughter of the rival gang's leader, but his love is threatened when the two gangs decide to forge family ties.

title: Kanni Rasi
desc: Lakshmipathy falls for his niece, Dhanalakshmi, and decides to marry her. However, their wedding gets cancelled when an astrologer predicts his death if they both marry.

title: Mr. Romeo
desc: A man enjoys the luxuries of life as a celebrity in Bangalore. However, his life is upended when he stumbles upon a series of medical crimes and decides to expose the perpetrator.

title: Anniyan
desc: Ramanujam, who suffers from multiple personality disorder, works as a lawyer by day and a vigilante at night. He uses tips from the 'Garuda Purana' as his tools to expose various antisocial elements.
